logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of 99mTc-complexes was determined by calculating the Do/w with the shake-flask method. Specifically, in a centrifuge tube containing 1.5 mL of 1-octanol and 1.5 mL PBS (0.1 M, pH 7.4), 50 μL (∼ 74 kBq) of the isolated complex solution was added. Then, the mixture was vortexed at room temperature for 1 min and centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 5 min. The radioactivity of aliquots (0.1 mL) of both 1-octanol and PBS phases was counted in a gamma counter. A sample (0.5 mL) from the octanol layer was subsequently repartitioned in octanol/buffer until constant values were obtained. The D7.4 was calculated by dividing the counts in the 1-octanol phase by those in the buffer, and the results are expressed as averaged logD7.4 values. The measurement was done in triplicate and repeated three times.36
